title: Three Kingdoms 7: The Battle of Red Cliffs (Part Two)

series.title: Three Kingdoms 7: The Battle of Red Cliffs (Part Two)

fullText.simplified:
第4章、好久不见

    庞统对曹操说，因为他故意在山里等蒋干，所以蒋干才能遇到他。
    没错，蒋干遇到庞统，这虽然是好事，但曹操还是有点儿不敢相信，庞统是不是故意的呢？如果是故意的，他为什么这样做呢？现在好了，庞统不但是个聪明人，还是个心里有话就会说的聪明人，他自己把真话说出来了。
    曹操的担心没有了。他大笑着说：“凤雏先生，从今天开始，您就在我这儿工作吧！”
    庞统说：“很高兴为您工作，我想先为您做另一件事。周瑜打了黄盖，很多江东人都很生气，我想回去和这些人说一说，让他们投降您。”
    曹操问：“您也觉得周瑜错了吗？”
    庞统说：“黄盖是江东的老将军，周瑜不应该打他。”
    曹操点头说：“凤雏先生，您去江东要小心，我等您回来。”
    庞统点头。他喝完杯里的酒，然后站起来，高兴地离开了。
    他走到江边，正准备坐船，突然有个人从后面走来，大声说：“庞统！你好大胆！周瑜先打黄盖，黄盖再来投降，然后你来见曹大人，让他把船连在一起！你们想做什么？放火烧船吗？”
    庞统的心马上跳到了嘴边，他害怕得说不出话，吃惊地看着说话的人。
    说话的人站在江边，脸上带着笑，也看着他。
    这是——“徐元直！”庞统吃惊地大叫。
    “没错，是我，好久不见，你好吗？”徐元直笑着说。
    庞统的害怕变成了高兴。原来他和徐元直是认识了很多年的好朋友，刚才是徐元直和他开玩笑呢。
    庞统笑着说：“听说你在刘备那儿工作，怎么来曹操这儿了？”
    徐元直说：“这是一件难过的事，下次见面再告诉你。今天太危险了，曹操那么聪明，你不怕他杀你？”
    庞统笑着说：“曹操没有你聪明。你已经看明白了，他还没看明白。”
    徐元直说：“诸葛亮和周瑜，这两个人在一起，事情一定不简单。曹操——要败了。”
    庞统说：“我们是老朋友了，你听我的话，别在曹操这儿了，快离开吧。”
    徐元直点头说：“是啊，这儿虽然热闹，但不能留了。”
    “你打算去哪儿？回刘备那儿吗？”庞统问。
    徐元直想了想，说：“我有点儿累了，想休息一下，打算回山里去。”
    庞统笑了：“等我帮周将军打完这一仗，就去山里找你。”
    徐元直大笑：“好，我会买好酒，等你来！”
fullText.traditional:
第4章、好久不見

    龐統對曹操說，因為他故意在山裡等蔣幹，所以蔣幹才能遇到他。
    沒錯，蔣幹遇到龐統，這雖然是好事，但曹操還是有點兒不敢相信，龐統是不是故意的呢？如果是故意的，他為什麼這樣做呢？現在好了，龐統不但是個聰明人，還是個心裡有話就會說的聰明人，他自己把真話說出來了。
    曹操的擔心沒有了。他大笑著說：“鳳雛先生，從今天開始，您就在我這兒工作吧！”
    龐統說：“很高興為您工作，我想先為您做另一件事。周瑜打了黃蓋，很多江東人都很生氣，我想回去和這些人說一說，讓他們投降您。”
    曹操問：“您也覺得周瑜錯了嗎？”
    龐統說：“黃蓋是江東的老將軍，周瑜不應該打他。”
    曹操點頭說：“鳳雛先生，您去江東要小心，我等您回來。”
    龐統點頭。他喝完杯裡的酒，然後站起來，高興地離開了。
    他走到江邊，正準備坐船，突然有個人從後面走來，大聲說：“龐統！你好大膽！周瑜先打黃蓋，黃蓋再來投降，然後你來見曹大人，讓他把船連在一起！你們想做什麼？放火燒船嗎？”
    龐統的心馬上跳到了嘴邊，他害怕得說不出話，吃驚地看著說話的人。
    說話的人站在江邊，臉上帶著笑，也看著他。
    這是——“徐元直！”龐統吃驚地大叫。
    “沒錯，是我，好久不見，你好嗎？”徐元直笑著說。
    龐統的害怕變成了高興。原來他和徐元直是認識了很多年的好朋友，剛才是徐元直和他開玩笑呢。
    龐統笑著說：“聽說你在劉備那兒工作，怎麼來曹操這兒了？”
    徐元直說：“這是一件難過的事，下次見面再告訴你。今天太危險了，曹操那麼聰明，你不怕他殺你？”
    龐統笑著說：“曹操沒有你聰明。你已經看明白了，他還沒看明白。”
    徐元直說：“諸葛亮和周瑜，這兩個人在一起，事情一定不簡單。曹操——要敗了。”
    龐統說：“我們是老朋友了，你聽我的話，別在曹操這兒了，快離開吧。”
    徐元直點頭說：“是啊，這兒雖然熱鬧，但不能留了。”
    “你打算去哪兒？回劉備那兒嗎？”龐統問。
    徐元直想了想，說：“我有點兒累了，想休息一下，打算回山裡去。”
    龐統笑了：“等我幫周將軍打完這一仗，就去山裡找你。”
    徐元直大笑：“好，我會買好酒，等你來！”

sentences.pinyin: nǐ dǎ suàn qù nǎ'r huí liú bèi nà'r ma páng tǒng wèn
sentences.english: “Where are you planning to go? Are you going back to Liu Bei?” Pang Tong asked.

sentences.simplified: 徐元直想了想，说：“我有点儿累了，想休息一下，打算回山里去。”
sentences.traditional: 徐元直想了想，說：“我有點兒累了，想休息一下，打算回山裡去。”
sentences.pinyin: xú yuán zhí xiǎng le xiǎng shuō wǒ yǒu diǎn'r lèi le xiǎng xiū xi yí xià dǎ suàn huí shān lǐ qù
sentences.english: Xu Yuanzhi thought about it and said, “I’m a little tired and want to take a break. I plan to return to the mountains.”

sentences.simplified: 庞统笑了：“等我帮周将军打完这一仗，就去山里找你。”
sentences.traditional: 龐統笑了：“等我幫周將軍打完這一仗，就去山裡找你。”
sentences.pinyin: páng tǒng xiào le děng wǒ bāng zhōu jiāng jūn dǎ wán zhè yí zhàng jiù qù shān lǐ zhǎo nǐ
sentences.english: Pang Tong smiled, “After I help General Zhou with this battle, I’ll come find you in the mountains.”

sentences.simplified: 徐元直大笑：“好，我会买好酒，等你来！”
sentences.traditional: 徐元直大笑：“好，我會買好酒，等你來！”
sentences.pinyin: xú yuán zhí dà xiào hǎo wǒ huì mǎi hǎo jiǔ děng nǐ lái
sentences.english: Xu Yuanzhi laughed loudly, “Good, I will buy good wine and wait for you to come!”

sentence_translations: Chapter 4: Long Time No See
Pang Tong said to Cao Cao that Jiang Gan was able to encounter him because he deliberately waited in the mountains.
Indeed, Jiang Gan’s encounter with Pang Tong was a good thing, but Cao Cao still didn’t quite dare to believe it.
Did Pang Tong do this on purpose? If it was intentional, why did he do it?
Now it was clear. Pang Tong was not only an smart person, but also an smart person who spoke his mind. He spoke the truth.
Cao Cao’s worries disappeared.
He laughed loudly and said, “Mr. Fledgling Phoenix , from today onwards, you will work here for me!”
Pang Tong said, “I am very happy to work for you. I would first like to do another thing for you.”
Zhou Yu attacked Huang Gai. Many people in Jiangdong are very angry.
I want to go back to talk to these people and get them them to surrender to you.”
Cao Cao asked, “You also think that Zhou Yu was wrong?”
Pang Tong said, “Huang Gai is an old general from Jiangdong. Zhou Yu should not have attacked him.”
Cao Cao nodded and said, “Mr.  Fledgling Phoenix, be careful in Jiangdong. I will wait for your return.”
Pang Tong nodded. He finished the drink in his glass, then stood up and left happily.
He walked to the bank of the river. Just as he was about to board a boat, someone suddenly came up from behind and shouted, ..
.. “Pang Tong! You are so bold! Zhou Yu attacked Huang Gai first, and then Huang Gai came to surrender.
Afterward, you went to see Lord Cao and asked him to connect the boats together!
What do you want to do? Set fire to burn the boats?”
Pang Tong’s heart immediately jumped into his mouth.
He was so scared that words didn’t come out. He looked at the person who spoke in shock.
The person who spoke was standing by the river. He had a smile on his face and was looking at him.
This was—“Xu Yuanzhi!” Pang Tong exclaimed in surprise.
“Indeed, it’s me. Long time no see. How have you been?” Xu Yuanzhi said with a smile.
Pang Tong’s fear turned into joy.
Actually, he and Xu Yuanzhi had been good friends for many years, and Xu Yuanzhi was playing a joke on him just then.
Pang Tong smiled and said, “I heard that you are working for Liu Bei. How did you end up here with Cao Cao?”
Xu Yuanzhi said, “This is a sad story. I’ll tell you the next time we meet.
Today, it is too dangerous. Cao Cao is so smart. Aren’t you afraid he will kill you?”
Pang Tong smiled and said, “Cao Cao is not as smart as you. You’ve already understood, but he still hasn’t.”
Xu Yuanzhi said, “With Zhuge Liang and Zhou Yu together, things are definitely not simple. Cao Cao—he’s going to be defeated.
Pang Tong said, “We’re old friends. Listen to me. Don’t stay here with Cao Cao. Leave quickly.”
Xu Yuanzhi nodded and said, “Yes, although it’s lively here, I can’t stay.”
“Where are you planning to go? Are you going back to Liu Bei?” Pang Tong asked.
Xu Yuanzhi thought about it and said, “I’m a little tired and want to take a break. I plan to return to the mountains.”
Pang Tong smiled, “After I help General Zhou with this battle, I’ll come find you in the mountains.”
Xu Yuanzhi laughed loudly, “Good, I will buy good wine and wait for you to come!”
